criteria.description: The criteria text sent to the decision model: when a caller's words mean this intent ("Wants to cancel an existing appointment"). Sent as it is, so a change re-keys a recorded cassette.

label.description: The spoken label ("track a parcel"), used in acknowledgements and confirmations ("I'd be happy to help you track a parcel").

kind.description: form: starts the form of the same id in forms.yaml. informational: plays its promptId (or says its passage, or switches to its locale) and resumes. control: the engine's own (agent, repeat_prompt, done, other, none).

promptId.description: For an informational intent, the prompt played (an id in prompts.yaml). An informational intent names this, `passage` or `locale` (`locale` may go with this).

passage.description: For an informational intent, in place of promptId: a passage of the knowledge base (an id in kb/passages), said word for word through the kb_answer line. No retrieval and no gate: the passage in force today for its topic, in the call's language, for every caller (it has no applies). When none can be said, the kb_unavailable line is said and a person offered, once per call.

locale.description: For an informational intent: the locale the call switches to when it is chosen (one of the app's). Its promptId, if any, is said in that locale, then the call resumes; a speech channel is asked to switch its voice and recognition too (set_language, with the languages app.yaml's voice.locales names). Goes with promptId or alone, not with passage.

unsure.description: When the model is unsure of this intent (outside a form, read from INTENT_EXPLICIT, 0.4, up to INTENT_IMPLICIT, 0.6): "confirm" asks the caller ("Just to check, do you want to ...?"), "no-match" takes it as no match (the no-match line, counted). For a form intent, an informational one and done. Default: app.yaml's unsureIntent, else "confirm".

priority.description: Something that must never wait or be missed, such as an emergency or a safety report. Read at PRIORITY_INTENT (0.8) or more, the intent is acted on this turn: mid-form over the question being answered and any pending confirmation (the form in hand is left, as on a switch), and never ignored as side speech or re-asked as unintelligible. A handoff to a person and the injection screen still stand. true reads PRIORITY_INTENT; { threshold: NAME } reads another. For a form intent or an informational one. Default false.

threshold.description: The threshold the intent is read against in place of PRIORITY_INTENT: one of the engine's, or one under thresholds in app.yaml.

intents.description: Every intent the app hears, by id, in the order the decision model is offered them. Each form intent has a form of the same id in forms.yaml; `agent` and `repeat_prompt` are required control intents.

digit.description: The key the caller presses, as a quoted string ("1"; an unquoted 1 is a number in YAML).

intent.description: The intent that key chooses (an id under `intents`).

items.description: One key of the keypad menu.

menu.description: The keypad menu: digit to intent, in the order it is read out. May be empty for an app with no keypad menu.

description: intents.yaml: what a caller can ask for, and the keypad menu.
